{"claims":[{"claim_text":"In 2012, then-Vice President Biden worked alongside President Obama to establish the Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA) program.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"President Biden has taken steps to support undocumented people and families, including Dreamers and DACA recipients.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"President Biden has vigorously defended DACA against legal challenges in the courts.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"President Biden has extended Affordable Care Act coverage to DACA recipients for the first time.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"President Biden is taking action to make it easier for Dreamers, including DACA recipients, who have earned a higher education degree in the United States and have a job offer to more quickly receive work visas.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Administration allowed undocumented workers in labor disputes to apply for deferred action so that they are not afraid to report violations of labor law.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Trump tried to end the DACA program in his first term.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Trump will try to end the DACA program again if re-elected.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"President Biden announced new actions to keep an estimated 500,000 American families together by allowing certain noncitizen spouses and children of U.S. citizens who have been in the country for 10 years or more to apply for lawful permanent residence—a status they're already eligible for—without leaving the country first.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The average beneficiary of the new actions has been in the United States for more than 20 years.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Beneficiaries of the new actions will be able to come out of the shadows and fully contribute to communities.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
